section.sectionSummaryBrief: This section explains that the unique revelation of the World to Come is the aspect of Eden, a delight beyond even the delight in Torah and mitzvos.
section.t: And the explanation of the matter
(of these three levels,
Gan Eden and the two levels of Techiyas HaMeisim),
is that it is stated in the Gemara26
All the prophets, all of them, only prophesied concerning the days of Moshiach, but concerning the World to Come, “No eye has seen, O God, besides You.”27
“No eye has seen, O God, besides You.”
And in the continuation of the matter there: “What is ‘No eye has seen’? This is Eden, over which no eye of any creature has ruled.”
Lest you say: Where was Adam HaRishon? He was in the Garden, etc.
The Garden is one thing and Eden is another.
And this is that the innovation and superiority of the World to Come
(Techiyas HaMeisim)
over the days of Moshiach is that then there will be the revelation of the aspect of Eden,
“No eye has seen.”
And from this it is understood
that this [revelation] which will be in the World to Come—the revelation of the drawing down that was drawn down through the fulfillment of the mitzvos—
since this revelation will be
(in general)
also in the days of Moshiach,
is not the true essence of the matter of the World to Come.
And the main matter of the World to Come is the revelation of the aspect of Eden,
and it is the essential delight that delights in Yisrael,
which is above even the delight that delights in Torah and mitzvos28.
And to note,
that in many places29
the distinction between Torah and mitzvos is explained,
that in Torah, which is His wisdom, the illumination of delight is clothed, and in mitzvos, which are His will, the essence of delight is clothed
(the aspect of Eden).
And this is that regarding Gan Eden it is written30
“And a river went out from Eden to water the Garden,”
that the delight drawn to the souls in Gan Eden
(in the comprehension of Torah)
is only a contracted drawing from the aspect of Eden, drawn through the river that separates between Eden and the Garden,
but in the World to Come, which is the reward of the mitzvos, it is the revelation of the aspect of Eden itself.
And it can be said
that this is in general.
But in particular,
since the revelation of the mitzvos will be
(in general)
also in the days of Moshiach, and nevertheless they said that in the days of Moshiach there will not be the revelation of the aspect of “No eye has seen”
(the aspect of Eden),
and the revelation of this aspect will be only in the World to Come,
it is proven from this
that the main aspect of Eden that will be in the World to Come is that then the essential delight that delights in Yisrael will be revealed,
which is above even the essential delight in the mitzvos.

section.sectionSummaryBrief: This section explains the superiority of Techiyas HaMeisim over the days of Moshiach, and the distinction between Gan Eden and the days of Moshiach regarding the nature of ascents.
section.t: And the explanation of the superiority of Techiyas HaMeisim over the days of Moshiach
(and likewise the distinction between the two levels within Techiyas HaMeisim itself),
will be understood by first explaining the superiority of the days of Moshiach over Gan Eden31.
For the revelation of Gan Eden is specifically to souls without bodies,
but the revelation of the days of Moshiach will be also below, in this physical world
(and as [it says]: “In the future, Eretz Yisrael will produce fine cakes”32).
And the reason for this is,
because in Gan Eden it is the revelation of the Or HaMemaleh,
a limited light,
and therefore it does not extend below,
but in the days of Moshiach there will be the revelation of the unlimited Ein Sof,
and therefore the revelation will be also below.
And another distinction:
In Gan Eden there are, in general, two aspects,
Lower Gan Eden and Upper Gan Eden,
and in each of them there are numerous levels without end33,
as our sages said34
“Torah scholars have no rest, etc., they go from strength to strength”35,
that they always ascend from level to level.
And the explanation of “they have no rest” is that their ascent from level to level is through avodah.
For in the ascent, one must first immerse in the River of Fire to forget the comprehension and delight of the lower level36,
and also the ascent itself is through the pillar37
that is between level and level,
that through this as well he is nullified from his previous comprehension,

except that the nullification through immersion in the River of Fire is the nullification from the side of the lower [level], and the nullification through the pillar is that he is nullified from the side of the revelation of the light of the upper level that shines upon him38.
And this is that the ascent from level to level is through avodah
(“they have no rest”),
the avodah of nullification,
similar to the avodah below in this world,
whose entirety is to refine the creations39,
purification and nullification,
avodah from the term “processing of hides”40.
And it should be added,
that just as the avodah below is in two lines,
“turn from evil and do good,”
so too is it regarding the nullification in the ascents of Gan Eden,
that it is in these two lines.
The nullification through the River of Fire—analogous to the avodah of “turn from evil,” so to speak,
and the nullification through the pillar,
from the side of the revelation of the upper light—analogous to the avodah of “and do good.”
All this is in Gan Eden.
But regarding the revelation that will be in the days of Moshiach,
although there will also be many ascents then,
the ascents that will be then will not be in the manner of “they go from strength to strength,”
that in order to reach a more elevated level one must go
(leave and be nullified)
from the previous level,
but rather, even while he is in his previous level, he can ascend to the upper level
(by himself).

section.sectionSummaryBrief: This section explains that the ascents in Gan Eden require stripping away garments due to the nature of the Or HaMemaleh, unlike the revelation of Ein Sof in the days of Moshiach which reaches below without such nullification.
section.t: And it can be said the explanation of this,
that the drawing down of the Or HaMemaleh to enliven and bring into being the creations is in a manner of hishtalshelus from above to below.
That initially it is clothed in the spiritual creations,
and afterwards it is clothed in the creations that are below them,
which are only like a parable to the upper creations,
and afterwards it is clothed further below41,
and as is known regarding the matter of “and he spoke three thousand parables”42.
And it can be said
that this is the reason that the ascent in Gan Eden
(for in Gan Eden it is the revelation of the Or HaMemaleh,
as above)
from level to level is through being nullified from the lower level,
for just as the drawing down from above to below is through being clothed in yet another garment and yet another garment,
so too is it regarding the ascent from below to above,
that the ascent is through the stripping away of the garment,
nullification of the previous level43.
[And it can be said,
that this is also what is brought in several discourses44
that even the Avos and Moshe Rabbeinu, who sit in the Upper Gan Eden for more than three thousand years, will come to be clothed in bodies,
because the revelation that will be in Techiyas HaMeisim is much more elevated than the revelation that shines in Gan Eden,
even in the Upper Gan Eden.
For this that they are precise “who sit in the Upper Gan Eden for more than three thousand years,”
it can be said
that three thousand years are analogous to the three thousand parables,
which correspond to the three worlds of Beriah, Yetzirah, and Asiyah,
for in each world there are a thousand levels.
And this is that they are precise “who sit in the Upper Gan Eden for more than three thousand years,”
that during the course of three thousand years they strip off all the garments
(the parables)
of the three worlds of Beriah, Yetzirah, and Asiyah,
and when they sit in Gan Eden for more than three thousand years they also ascend in Atzilus, etc.,
and nevertheless they will come to be clothed in bodies,
because the revelation of Techiyas HaMeisim is above the revelation of Gan Eden,
even when the revelation of Gan Eden is after stripping off all the garments].
But the ascents that will be in the days of Moshiach will be in a manner that one will not need to leave his state and level,
since then there will be the revelation of the unlimited Ein Sof,
and the revelation will be also below.
